field.title: New-application notification address
field.description: Receives an email each time an application is submitted. Leave empty to turn notifications off.

field.title: n8n webhook URL for staff decisions
field.description: Receives a POST when staff accept, reject or request more information on an application in manual review. Leave empty to turn it off. The shared secret is read from the C_STEP_INTAKE_N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN environment variable.
